profit_layer.objective: Maximize long-run expected GP growth, not headline ROI. Prefer high probability-weighted GP per unit time, scalable capacity, reliable execution, low player-time cost and low correlation.
profit_layer.allocation_rule: With unknown liquid cash, deploy incrementally down the marginal-capital ladder to modeled capacity. Fast flips require persistent-spread validation before allocation. Phase-2 fast flips use the price pair that maximizes modeled probability-weighted GP/hour; GE slots are ranked separately by GP per slot-hour. Phase-3 minimum absolute-profit hurdles remain observation-only until their promotion rule is satisfied.

conversion_capacity_velocity.strategy: 1xDivine super combat potion(4)->Divine super combat potion(1)

ge_slot_optimizer.metric: probability-weighted GP per GE-slot-hour after modeled execution, tax, slippage and player-time adjustments
ge_slot_optimizer.rule: ACTIVE is reserved for short-cycle velocity, PARKING for patient evergreen/crash-catcher capital, and FLEXIBLE for relative-value or opportunistic use. Targets are soft architecture, not rigid caps; actual free-slot counts remain upper bounds until user-confirmed.

minimum_absolute_profit_hurdles.evaluation_basis: Probability-weighted expected profit at modeled capacity after tax, slippage, execution probability and any player-time shadow cost.
minimum_absolute_profit_hurdles.promotion_rule: Observe at least 12 relay cycles and 50 evaluated candidates. Promote only after review confirms the hurdles reduce low-value slot use without suppressing repeatable realized GP; changing rollout_status to ALLOCATION_AUTHORITATIVE is an explicit later decision.

real_execution_learning.rule: Real user-confirmed orders outrank shadow observations. Fill-time curves use only orders with known placement timestamps and only horizons with enough observation time; unknown timestamps never become negative samples.

spread_persistence.rule: Fast flips are not automatic-allocation eligible until a spread persists across at least three consecutive snapshots and the minimum time window with fresh HIGH/LOW prints, both sides trading, adequate volume and retained positive edge. REPEATABLE_MARKET requires a longer observation chain.

profit_layer.allocation_note: Exact GP allocation is intentionally not optimized when current liquid cash is unknown; the capital frontier ranks opportunities by expected GP velocity, capacity and execution quality.

records.summary: Breaker requires Ascension Shards plus a rune of some kind; the specific rune was not decided in the cited proposal.
records.market_pricing_assessment: Treat all rune-specific beneficiary calls as speculation until narrowed or confirmed.

records.summary: Prayer scroll supply weights were reduced while Ancestral relative weighting increased.
records.market_pricing_assessment: Fundamental supply changes are confirmed, but subsequent price direction must be read from live tape rather than assumed.

records.summary: All six proposed Fractured Archive rewards passed: Elemental Fragments 85.8%, Rondache 80.7%, Zorya's Tome 90.4%, Zeal 86.1%, Ascension Crossbows 85.6%, Breaker 88.4%. The Obligator won the Breaker visual poll.
records.market_pricing_assessment: Existence risk for the proposed reward set is sharply reduced. Legacy elemental and Crush beneficiaries gain catalyst credibility, but exact encounter utility is still unconfirmed. Breaker's specific charge rune remains unknown, so Wrath-specific conviction should not be upgraded on beneficiary selection alone.

records.summary: The Jeweller's Chisel now cuts bolt tips from gems in 2 ticks instead of 5 and has a 1-in-10 chance to cut 2 gems into bolt tips at once. A hotfix temporarily slows only the first gem in a multi-gem sequence; subsequent gems retain the improved 2-tick rate.
records.market_pricing_assessment: Legacy bolt-tip supply can now respond much faster to profitable conversion margins. This weakens any scarcity-based bull thesis for Diamond/Onyx bolt tips and makes tip-output price compression more likely during arbitrage, while potentially increasing demand for source gems when conversion economics are attractive.

records.summary: The Abyssal Lantern now functions outside Guardians of the Rift when burning logs with applicable effects. Jagex explicitly states rune-boosting effects such as Blisterwood apply to base runes crafted outside GOTR, not extra runes from Scar Essence extracts or Blood essence.
records.market_pricing_assessment: This creates an incremental production-efficiency increase for altar-crafted base runes and therefore slightly reduces the scarcity ceiling for any existing rune selected as Breaker's charge rune. The specific Breaker rune probability is unchanged; the development affects expected supply response, not beneficiary selection.

records.summary: Courier Tasks now award stackable Loot Sacks. Each sack has a 1-in-5 chance to contain a supply bundle; Cairn Isle thematic bundles explicitly include uncut gems up to diamonds, while Entrana bundles include various bones with higher-level bones from higher-tier sacks. Other ports add runes, scales, shards, ores, bars, planks and consumables.
records.market_pricing_assessment: This is a new repeatable commodity source. Diamond supply receives a direct incremental headwind through uncut-diamond drops. Broad bone supply also increases, but Jagex did not enumerate the exact higher-level bone types in this post, so a Dragon-bones-specific impact should remain unconfirmed until the drop table is established.

records.summary: The lock-in poll passed the proposed ability to trade grown dogs to an NPC for 100 Blood Runes, increasing to 200 with completion of the Morytania Medium Diary, by 78.7% Yes. The source depends on A Ruff Situation being implemented as described and is therefore a future supply catalyst rather than a current live source.
records.market_pricing_assessment: This adds a poll-confirmed future Blood-rune source and increases Blood-rune supply elasticity. It matters to the Breaker competing-rune basket because Blood would have somewhat more supply response if selected, but it provides no evidence that Jagex is more or less likely to choose Blood, Wrath, or another rune.

records.summary: Jagex states that Bounty Tasks should not award Loot Sacks after next week's Game Update. Courier Tasks remain the intended Loot Sack source, so the upcoming change removes a temporary unintended extra path feeding the same commodity bundles.
records.market_pricing_assessment: Near-term Loot Sack commodity inflow should fall when the Bounty Task award path is removed. This partially offsets, but does not invalidate, the Aug 26 bearish supply catalyst because Courier Tasks continue to generate sacks. The effect is most relevant to high-volume bounty participation and should be treated as a supply-rate correction rather than a beneficiary reversal.

rule: Routine desk runs should use this lite packet only. Use the marginal-capital ladder for incremental GP, the absolute-velocity frontier for total GP/hour, the GE-slot-hour frontier for scarce slot allocation, and the balanced frontier for final risk-adjusted ranking. Fast flips require spread persistence before allocation and Phase-2 optimal prices are allocation-authoritative only after that gate clears. Phase-3 minimum absolute-profit hurdles are observation-only until explicitly promoted. Fetch the deep packet solely for missing fields or a user-requested deep dive.
